IMAGE="gcr.io/${PROJECT_ID}/myapp:${BUILD_TAG}"
docker build --pull -t "${IMAGE}" .

Main build-time fixes:

2. **Use multi-stage build** — Separate the build image from the runtime image; the final image stays small and pushes faster to the primary region registry.

3. **Add `.dockerignore`** — Exclude `node_modules`, `.git`, and local build artifacts so the context sent to the daemon stays minimal.

Optimized Dockerfile:
```dockerfile
# ---- Build stage ----
FROM node:18-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./          # Cache-friendly: deps only
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

# ---- Runtime stage ----
FROM node:18-alpine            # Smaller image, faster deploy
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=builder /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY package*.json ./
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```
